changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.comment: purpose_priority is an allowlist per purpose ({"CHAT": ["m1","m2"], "VISION": []}), not a hint: the resolver picks the first live model of the list and never searches the registry by modality on its own. That is why an ordered list replaces the single default_model — one model could only ever answer for chat, and picking a vision or image model implicitly meant guessing which of the provider's models the user is willing to pay for. A missing key and an empty list are different: no key = not configured yet, [] = the purpose is switched off deliberately; both are reported to the user instead of being worked around.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE llm_providers SET purpose_priority = jsonb_build_object('CHAT', jsonb_build_array(default_model)) WHERE default_model IS NOT NULL AND btrim(default_model) <> ''
